text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Guess it's time to head back—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...! Messiah...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... Hello, Pocket-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey. ...Surprised to see you in a place 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was thinking of visiting a place 
I don't usually go to.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Um... ...It's to break out of my shell."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If I don't change and truly break out of 
my shell, there's no future for me... 
Sometimes, that's how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And so, it suddenly hit me... that if I 
did something I wouldn't normally do, 
maybe something would change."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's gonna get dark soon, right? 
Why not save the adventure for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Around here, it gets pretty noisy at 
night."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see. ...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "...I'm heading home now. What about you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm here, I think I'll gaze at the 
river a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Knowing you were there after I plucked 
up my courage... I felt a little relieved, 
Senpai."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While hanging out with her friends, Jungle 
Pocket wandered off somewhere on a whim... 
and somehow returned bringing Air Messiah 
along with her.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A lot of shady folks hang around there at 
night. I figured it'd be better than 
letting her be alone... but still.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...E-Excuse me for intruding.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She really stands out. Maybe I should've 
just sent her home?
choice_data_list:
Why don't you try treating her like one of 
your friends?
Let's watch over them for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But, like, she's kinda all over the 
place, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it kinda bad if I just do the same 
thing as everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking action when she wants to change 
something, fearlessly keeping up with 
Jungle Pocket... She surely must have a 
strong core deep down.
choice_data_list:
I think you'll be just fine if you stick 
to your usual routine.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right! Treating 'em like a guest might 
actually backfire, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Messiah. You said you wanted to do 
something you wouldn't normally do 
yourself, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Darts! Wanna give it a shot?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —L-Like... this?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're way off! Man, this is 
hilarious...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Are you teasing me?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ... No? Not at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, take your stance one more time. I 
won't laugh this time. ...Alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket continued teaching Air 
Messiah how to play darts, playfully 
teasing her as she struggled.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even if you say watch over them...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is this... this week's issue of "Shonen 
Kick"...!?

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pal A
text_block_list.text:
! You read this too? It's a shonen manga, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I just love shonen manga! Lately, 
every single series in "Shonen Kick" has 
been on fire.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Especially now, as we reach the climax—

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pal B
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, that author drew *that* manga too?! 
Isn't the art style way too different?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"In an interview, they mentioned adapting 
their style depending on whether it's for 
shonen or seinen magazines."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"When you read it closely, the theme is 
consistent... It's wonderful how their 
stance never wavers, no matter who the 
reader is."

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pal B
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! Awesome! You really know 
everything, huh! Ah, want a snack? Hang on 
a sec!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa.
choice_data_list: Seems my worrying was for nothing.
Seems my worrying was for nothing, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. Honestly, we were the ones in 
danger. Felt like she was gonna snatch the 
top spot in no time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Now that's got some real guts, sheesh...
